parameters.name: api_key
parameters.description: The API key obtained from the Memset control panel.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The Memstore product name (that is, mstestyaa1).

examples:
- name: Get usage for mstestyaa1
  community.general.memset_memstore_info:
    name: mstestyaa1
    api_key: 5eb86c9896ab03919abcf03857163741
  delegate_to: localhost

return_values.name: memset_api
return_values.description: Info from the Memset API. Returned: always

return_values.name: bandwidth
return_values.description: Dictionary of CDN bandwidth facts. Returned: always

return_values.name: bytes_in
return_values.description: Inbound bandwidth for the last 24 hours in bytes. Returned: always Sample: 1000

return_values.name: bytes_out
return_values.description: Outbound bandwidth for the last 24 hours in bytes. Returned: always Sample: 1000

return_values.name: requests
return_values.description: Number of requests in the last 24 hours. Returned: always Sample: 10

return_values.name: bytes
return_values.description: Space used in bytes. Returned: always Sample: 3860997965

return_values.name: cdn_bandwidth
return_values.description: Dictionary of CDN bandwidth facts. Returned: always

return_values.name: containers
return_values.description: Number of containers. Returned: always Sample: 10

return_values.name: objs
return_values.description: Number of objects. Returned: always Sample: 1000
